en.Vertrauen entsteht durch Architektur, ni: Trust comes from architecture, not from promises. This page explains — for technically curious users — how identity proof, encryption, privacy and operation fit together, including the deliberate limits.
en.Der Anruf läuft direkt zwischen den Brow: The call runs directly between the browsers. The server only helps establish the connection — it never sees the content.
en.Video, Audio und Chat fließen per WebRTC: Video, audio and chat flow directly between participants via WebRTC. The server only brokers the technical connection data (signaling) and never relays media.
en.Jede Verbindung ist mit DTLS-SRTP versch: Every connection is encrypted with DTLS-SRTP — WebRTC’s standard mechanisms. The keys are negotiated directly between the browsers; the server does not know them.
en.Um durch Router und Firewalls zu finden,: To traverse routers and firewalls, WebRTC uses STUN and (on restrictive networks) TURN relays. A TURN relay only forwards the encrypted packets and cannot decrypt them.
en.Bei mehreren Teilnehmern hält jeder eine: With several participants, each keeps a direct connection to every other one (full mesh). Here too the server stays out of it — it distributes no media streams.
en.Ausweisen mit dem digitalen Personalausw: Identify with the digital ID (PID) from the EUDI Wallet — cryptographically verified, data-minimizing, and revealed only after both sides consent.
en.Namen und Attribute stammen aus dem Pers: Names and attributes come from the Personal Identification Data (PID) in the EUDI Wallet — officially confirmed rather than self-typed. Only genuine PID credentials are accepted.
en.Der Nachweis läuft über das Standard-Pro: The proof uses the standard OpenID4VP protocol within the European eIDAS 2.0 framework. A dedicated verifier service (EUDIPLO) does the cryptographic checking; the app only processes the verified result.
en.Die Sicherheit hängt am Aussteller, nich: Security depends on the issuer, not the file format: only the official PID type from a qualified issuer is accepted. Self-issued “PID-like” credentials are rejected via the verifier’s trust-anchor list.

The qualified electronic signature (QES) via a qualified trust service provider, and eventually directly from the EUDI wallet, is planned as the next stage.
en.Stellt euch vor, ihr wollt gemeinsam ein: Imagine you want to build a safe together without anyone on the phone overhearing the combination: each of you brings a publicly visible half of a mathematical lock. Combine both halves and a shared secret emerges — but only for the two of you who each hold your own half. That's exactly how your browsers negotiate the session key that encrypts the connection.
en.Die Wallet erhält vom Ausweisamt nicht e: The wallet doesn't receive a single slip with all your data from the registry office, but many individually sealed envelopes — one per field like name or date of birth, each with a random secret number inside. Across all envelopes together there's an officially signed list of fingerprints. If only "over 18" is requested, the wallet opens exactly that one envelope — the rest stay sealed, yet are still provably part of the same genuine ID via that list.
en.Eine Prüfsumme funktioniert wie ein Mixe: A checksum works like a blender: the file gets turned into a "smoothie" that can't be turned back into the original file. Two identical files always produce the exact same smoothie — change even a single byte, and a completely different one comes out. If both sides' smoothies match, the document has provably been transferred unchanged.
en.Rechtlich ist der Weg dahin bereits vorg: The legal path there is already mapped out: eIDAS 2.0 requires wallets to be able to create qualified signatures free of charge for private individuals for non-professional use. The signing key stays on a certified, "remote"-managed hardware module at the trust service provider; the wallet addresses it on your behalf. Early pilot projects are testing two models — wallet-controlled (the wallet shows the document and triggers the signature) and provider-controlled (the trust service provider runs the process, the wallet only provides strong authentication). A production rollout is expected from 2027, at a different pace per member state.
en.Wallet und Signaturdienst müssen sich au: The wallet and the signing service need to agree on a shared secret without the signing key ever leaving the secured hardware module — like mixing paint: both start with the same, publicly known bucket of base colour. Each side pours in its own secret colour — the resulting mixture can practically no longer be unmixed back into its ingredients. Both sides only exchange their finished mixtures, then each pours in their own secret colour once more — and independently arrive at exactly the same final colour. Anyone who only sees the exchanged mixtures can't reproduce that final colour.

fr.Stellt euch vor, ihr wollt gemeinsam ein: Imaginez que vous vouliez construire ensemble un coffre-fort sans que personne au téléphone puisse entendre la combinaison : chacun apporte une moitié, publiquement visible, d'une serrure mathématique. fr.Eine Prüfsumme funktioniert wie ein Mixe: Une somme de contrôle fonctionne comme un mixeur : le fichier est transformé en un « smoothie » à partir duquel on ne peut pas reconstituer le fichier d'origine. Deux fichiers identiques donnent toujours exactement le même smoothie — changez ne serait-ce qu'un seul octet, et un smoothie complètement différent en résulte. Si les smoothies des deux côtés concordent, le document a été transféré sans aucune modification, de façon prouvée.
fr.Rechtlich ist der Weg dahin bereits vorg: La voie légale est déjà tracée : eIDAS 2.0 impose aux portefeuilles de pouvoir créer des signatures qualifiées gratuitement pour les particuliers, dans un usage non professionnel. La clé de signature reste sur un module matériel certifié, géré « à distance », chez le prestataire de services de confiance ; le portefeuille le sollicite en votre nom. Les premiers projets pilotes testent deux modèles — piloté par le portefeuille (le portefeuille affiche le document et déclenche la signature) et piloté par le prestataire (le prestataire de confiance mène le processus, le portefeuille ne sert que d'authentification forte). Un déploiement en production est attendu à partir de 2027, à un rythme différent selon les États membres.
fr.Wallet und Signaturdienst müssen sich au: Le portefeuille et le service de signature doivent s'accorder sur un secret commun sans que la clé de signature ne quitte jamais le module matériel sécurisé — comme en mélangeant des couleurs : les deux commencent avec le même seau de couleur de base, connu publiquement. Quiconque ne voit que les mélanges échangés ne peut pas reproduire cette couleur finale.
